title: A real roulette table
summary: The roulette table is now a full model; the ball rolls around the wheel and drops in.
notes: Add low-poly 3D models for the roulette table (wheel, spinning rotor, rollable ball and dealer chip tray) and for the eight casino chip denominations, with 256px-or-smaller pixel-art textures.

Replace the placeholder roulette table with the new model: the rotor spins, the ball rolls around the track and drops into the winning pocket, and the table has a matching rectangular collider and sits clear of its neighbours.
